exposes_summary: state, presence, current_status, illuminance, hold_delay_time, sensitivity, trigger_distance, forbidden_area, ai_self_learning, fast_setting, indicator, sensor_mode, single_mode, absence_circling_report, absence_circling_interval, find_device, enable_sensor, factory_reset, lux_mode, daylight_threshold, lux_report_mode, lux_timed_interval, lux_difference_threshold, lux_difference_value, interference_positions, home_environment

exposes.name: Presence
exposes.description: Indicates whether the device detected presence.

exposes.name: Luminance
exposes.description: Measured illuminance.

exposes.name: Hold delay time
exposes.description: Delay (seconds) before switching from Presence to Absence after no motion is detected. Recommended ≥ 15s to avoid premature Absence switching..

exposes.name: Sensitivity
exposes.description: Sensitivity of human presence detection: • High: suitable for environments with minimal motion interference, such as meeting rooms or cloakrooms away from windows. • Medium: suitable for most scenarios, such as living rooms or restaurants. • Low: suitable for environments with some minor motion interference, such as bedrooms. .

exposes.name: Trigger distance
exposes.description: Distance within which the sensor detects motion, adjustable from 0.5m to 4m, in 0.5m steps..

exposes.name: Forbidden area
exposes.description: Distance from the sensor within which motion is ignored to prevent false detection (0-1.8m)..

exposes.name: AI environment self-learning
exposes.description: AI self-learning to help the sensor ignore non-human motion in the environment. The learning process takes 1 minute, during which the sensor will blink. Ensure the area is completely empty during this time..

exposes.name: Fast setting
exposes.description: Fast setting based on the size of the space: • Small: area less than 16m², e.g., tea room, bathroom. • Medium: area 16–25m², e.g., private office, public toilet, kitchen. • Large: area greater than 25m², e.g., open office, large conference room, living room. .

exposes.name: LED indicator
exposes.description: LED indicator providing a visual signal when motion is detected or the sensor changes state..

exposes.name: Sensor mode
exposes.description: Operating mode of the radar sensor: • Presence: detects micro-movements for continuous occupancy detection. • Motion: detects larger movements while ignoring small activity to reduce false triggers. .

exposes.name: Single mode
exposes.description: Suitable for spaces where only one person is present at a time. The sensor maintains Presence while the person is within range and automatically switches to Absence 15 seconds after they leave..

exposes.name: Absence circling report
exposes.description: Periodic reporting of the Absence state after the sensor switches to Absence, it will send regular status updates automatically..

exposes.name: Absence circling interval
exposes.description: Interval (minutes) between periodic Absence reports after switching to Absence..

exposes.name: Find device
exposes.description: Indicator LED flashes to help locate the sensor..

exposes.name: Enable sensor
exposes.description: Enable or disable the sensor..

exposes.name: Factory reset
exposes.description: Restores factory defaults, removing all customized settings..

exposes.name: Lux mode
exposes.description: Lux sensor operation mode: • Threshold: triggers based on a fixed daylight level. • Report: periodically reports light levels using time-based or change-based intervals. .

exposes.name: Daylight threshold
exposes.description: Lux level defining sufficient natural light (daylight), applicable only when Lux mode is set to Threshold..

exposes.name: Lux report mode
exposes.description: Reporting style when Lux mode is set to Report: • Timed: sends light level updates at fixed intervals. • Difference: (Not implemented on this device) reports only when lux changes exceed a set threshold. .

exposes.name: Lux timed interval
exposes.description: Interval (seconds) for timed lux reports when Lux report mode is set to Timed..

exposes.name: Lux difference threshold
exposes.description: Lux change required to trigger a report when Lux report mode is set to Difference. Note: This device does not support Difference reporting, so this setting has no effect. .

exposes.name: Lux difference value
exposes.description: Reported lux value for Difference mode. Note: This device does not support Difference reporting, so this setting has no effect. .

exposes.name: Interference positions
exposes.description: List of distances (m) where non-human interference was detected..

exposes.name: Home environment
exposes.description: Environmental interference level detected by the sensor..
